Musical Key: E-flat Major

This is hymn number 286 titled "Oh, What Songs of the Heart" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Joseph J. Daynes and the lyrics were written by Eliza R. Snow.
